'''Pyroprawn''' is a [[Fire]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Shrimpyro]] at 6 bronze stars, and evolves into [[Pyroclobster]] at 18 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Obsessed with training and often trains with [[Capobeetle]]. Kind of clumsy when not training, but Pyroprawn brings a saving-the-world energy everywhere that makes it hard to stay mad."

Pyroprawn is a gold rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A red crustacean with a white underbelly, blue eyes, and orange claws that resemble boxing gloves on fire. It has a light yellow V-shape between its eyes.

Pyroprawn's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces red with magenta, orange with pink, and yellow/orange becomes peach.

== Evolution Trial ==
Pyroprawn's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 18 stars. To evolve it into [[Pyroclobster]] you need to complete the following two tasks:
* Feed Pyroprawn to increase stats 3 times.
* Play Snowboard Sprint/Marathon Party (use x2000 boards) or Cozy Farm (use x4000 fertilizer).

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Pyroprawn! Combo move! Press → ↘ ↓ ↙ ← A for the ultimate!"
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Pyroprawn enjoys rescuing Tatari trapped by Zobos with powerful flaming fists. Always strikes a stylish entrance pose."
